<article 
	class="post-33 page type-page status-publish ast-article-single" id="post-33" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" itemscope="itemscope">
	<header class="entry-header ast-header-without-markup">

	<div class="entry-content clear" 
		itemprop="text"	>
<div style="height:50px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<div class="wp-block-uagb-info-box uagb-infobox__outer-wrap uagb-block-473bf1c3"><div class="uagb-infobox__content-wrap uagb-infobox uagb-infobox-has-icon uagb-infobox-icon-above-title uagb-infobox-image-valign-top uagb-infobox-enable-border-radius "><div class="uagb-ifb-left-right-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-content"><div class="uagb-ifb-title-wrap"><h3 class="uagb-ifb-title">Bem vindos a Paracuru Kite Village</h3></div><div class="uagb-ifb-text-wrap"><p class="uagb-ifb-desc">Entre as dunas de areia branca, próxima ao mar de tons azuis, venha esquecer a correria e viver bons momentos.</p></div></div></div></div></div>
<section class="wp-block-uagb-section uagb-section__wrap uagb-section__background-image alignfull uagb-block-9fb25f8c"><div class="uagb-section__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-section__inner-wrap">
<section class="wp-block-uagb-columns uagb-columns__wrap uagb-columns__background-undefined uagb-columns__stack-mobile uagb-columns__valign-center uagb-columns__gap-10 alignfull uagb-block-6e083e64"><div class="uagb-columns__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-columns__inner-wrap uagb-columns__columns-2">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-undefined uagb-block-6e6b5522"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap">
<div class="wp-block-image"><figure class="aligncenter size-large is-resized"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAS4AAACzAQMAAAANAWMpAAAAA1BMVEUAAACnej3aAAAAAXRSTlMAQObYZgAAAB1JREFUGBntwTEBAAAAwiD7p95tB2AAAAAAAADACxtFAAG/mHx7AAAAAElFTkSuQmCC" alt="" class="wp-image-330 lazyload" width="302" height="179"   data-src="https://paracurukitevillage.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/tripadvisor-opacity.png" data-srcset="https://paracurukitevillage.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/tripadvisor-opacity.png 402w, https://paracurukitevillage.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/tripadvisor-opacity-300x178.png 300w" data-sizes="auto" data-eio-rwidth="302" data-eio-rheight="179" /></figure></div>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-undefined uagb-block-82c80078"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-info-box uagb-infobox__outer-wrap uagb-block-301b643e"><div class="uagb-infobox__content-wrap uagb-infobox uagb-infobox-has-icon uagb-infobox-icon-above-title uagb-infobox-image-valign-top uagb-infobox-enable-border-radius "><div class="uagb-ifb-left-right-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-content"><div class="uagb-ifb-title-wrap"></div><div class="uagb-ifb-text-wrap"><p class="uagb-ifb-desc">Em meio as dunas e a vegetação tropical, a <strong>Paracuru Kite Village</strong> encanta os clientes pelo aconchego, tranquilidade e atmosfera agradável. A pousada recebeu em 2015 o&nbsp;<strong>Traveller’s Choice Awards</strong>&nbsp;da Tripadvisor, sendo considerada um dos 25 hotéis de&nbsp;<strong>melhor custo-benefício</strong>&nbsp;do Brasil.</p></div></div></div></div></div>
</div></div>
</div></section>
<p></p>
</div></section>
<section class="wp-block-uagb-columns uagb-columns__wrap uagb-columns__background-undefined uagb-columns__stack-mobile uagb-columns__valign-undefined uagb-columns__gap-10 alignfull uagb-block-e9cd166b"><div class="uagb-columns__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-columns__shape uagb-columns__shape-top"><svg></svg></div><div class="uagb-columns__inner-wrap uagb-columns__columns-2">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-undefined uagb-block-1f0be7f5"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-info-box uagb-infobox__outer-wrap uagb-block-36e28c76"><div class="uagb-infobox__content-wrap uagb-infobox uagb-infobox-has-icon uagb-infobox-icon-above-title uagb-infobox-image-valign-top uagb-infobox-enable-border-radius "><div class="uagb-ifb-left-right-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-content"><div class="uagb-ifb-image-icon-content uagb-ifb-imgicon-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-icon-wrap"><span class="uagb-ifb-icon"><svg></svg></span></div></div><div class="uagb-ifb-title-wrap"><h3 class="uagb-ifb-title">Estrutura e Localização</h3></div><div class="uagb-ifb-text-wrap"><p class="uagb-ifb-desc">Em meio as dunas e a vegetação tropical, a Paracuru Kite Village encanta os clientes pelo aconchego, tranquilidade e atmosfera agradável. A pousada recebeu em 2015 o&nbsp;Traveller’s Choice Awards&nbsp;da Tripadvisor, sendo considerada um dos 25 hotéis de&nbsp;melhor custo-benefício&nbsp;do Brasil.</p></div></div></div></div></div>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-image uagb-block-e60370a6"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap"></div></div>
</div><div class="uagb-columns__shape uagb-columns__shape-bottom" data-negative="false"><svg></svg></div></section>
<section class="wp-block-uagb-columns uagb-columns__wrap uagb-columns__background-undefined uagb-columns__stack-mobile uagb-columns__valign-undefined uagb-columns__gap-10 alignfull uagb-block-b8ee2ca5"><div class="uagb-columns__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-columns__shape uagb-columns__shape-top"><svg></svg></div><div class="uagb-columns__inner-wrap uagb-columns__columns-3">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-image uagb-block-310831fa"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap"></div></div>
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-undefined uagb-block-0de8fb5a"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-info-box uagb-infobox__outer-wrap uagb-block-7b462be4"><div class="uagb-infobox__content-wrap uagb-infobox uagb-infobox-has-icon uagb-infobox-icon-above-title uagb-infobox-image-valign-top uagb-infobox-enable-border-radius "><div class="uagb-ifb-left-right-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-content"><div class="uagb-ifb-image-icon-content uagb-ifb-imgicon-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-icon-wrap"><span class="uagb-ifb-icon"><svg></svg></span></div></div><div class="uagb-ifb-title-wrap"><h3 class="uagb-ifb-title">Natureza</h3></div><div class="uagb-ifb-text-wrap"><p class="uagb-ifb-desc">A pousada tem uma área de 2.500 m², junto a um parque natural e cortada por um rio, ideal para os amantes da natureza. Aproveite a oportunidade de apreciar os pássaros, iguanas e pequenos sagüis que aqui habitam.</p></div></div></div></div></div>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-image uagb-block-0b4f8610"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap"></div></div>
</div><div class="uagb-columns__shape uagb-columns__shape-bottom" data-negative="false"><svg></svg></div></section>
<section class="wp-block-uagb-columns uagb-columns__wrap uagb-columns__background-undefined uagb-columns__stack-mobile uagb-columns__valign-undefined uagb-columns__gap-10 alignfull uagb-block-de9834a1"><div class="uagb-columns__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-columns__shape uagb-columns__shape-top"><svg></svg></div><div class="uagb-columns__inner-wrap uagb-columns__columns-2">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-image uagb-block-acbdfecd"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap"></div></div>
<div class="wp-block-uagb-column uagb-column__wrap uagb-column__background-undefined uagb-block-9b318bed"><div class="uagb-column__overlay"></div><div class="uagb-column__inner-wrap">
<div class="wp-block-uagb-info-box uagb-infobox__outer-wrap uagb-block-c54663db"><div class="uagb-infobox__content-wrap uagb-infobox uagb-infobox-has-icon uagb-infobox-icon-above-title uagb-infobox-image-valign-top uagb-infobox-enable-border-radius "><div class="uagb-ifb-left-right-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-content"><div class="uagb-ifb-image-icon-content uagb-ifb-imgicon-wrap"><div class="uagb-ifb-icon-wrap"><span class="uagb-ifb-icon"><svg></svg></span></div></div><div class="uagb-ifb-title-wrap"><h3 class="uagb-ifb-title">Paracuru</h3></div><div class="uagb-ifb-text-wrap"><p class="uagb-ifb-desc">Imagine um local paradisíaco com&nbsp;20 km de lindas praias&nbsp;e as mais diversas paisagens. Dunas, coquerais, piscinas naturais, rios, mangues e lençóis paracuruenses (no período de fevereiro a maio). Aventure-se nos diversos esportes que a cidade oferece:&nbsp;kitesurf, windsurf, sandboard, surf ou stand up paddle. Paracuru irá te surpreender! Para saber mais&nbsp;veja matéria da Globo.</p></div></div></div></div></div>
</div></div>
</div><div class="uagb-columns__shape uagb-columns__shape-bottom" data-negative="false"><svg></svg></div></section>
